verdict.rationale: Rainforest's marketing names a pre-built embeddable component for chargebacks, so the platform has its own first-party chargeback handling. It is only a single glancing mention, and no docs describe how disputes work. Missing for 10: per-sub-merchant chargeback attribution, evidence submission via API or dashboard, automatic flow of dispute outcomes into seller balances or deposits, dispute webhooks, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, disputes are managed per seller — chargebacks land against the right sub-merchant, evidence is submitted via API or dashboard, and outcomes flow back into seller balances automatically

citations.quote: pre-built, embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks, merchant onboarding, and more
